image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown from a top-down perspective, clinging to a mossy tree trunk or rock surface. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and bands. Its limbs are visible, with digits gripping the surface. The tail is partially visible, extending downward. The background consists of a textured, moss-covered surface with some fallen leaves and debris.
